school: 奥地利古典主义作曲家（6岁巡演的神童，35年写600余部作品：41部交响曲、27部钢琴协奏曲、《费加罗的婚礼》《唐璜》《魔笛》等22部歌剧、《安魂曲》未竟）/萨尔茨堡大主教宫廷乐师、维也纳自由音乐家
historical_significance: 沃尔夫冈·阿玛多伊斯·莫扎特（1756-1791），生于萨尔茨堡音乐世家，6岁起随父在欧洲宫廷巡演，被称为'上帝的宠儿'。1781年与大主教决裂，成为维也纳最早以自由身份谋生的音乐家之一，靠委约、出版、演出与教学维生。他在短短35年内留下600余部作品，遍及当时所有体裁：41部交响曲、27部钢琴协奏曲、大量室内乐与奏鸣曲，以及《费加罗的婚礼》(1786)、《唐璜》(1787)、《女人心》(1790)、《魔笛》(1791)等歌剧——把音乐的肌理与戏剧的人物心理第一次熔为一体，让乐团'替角色思考'。他常在脑中整体完成作品再落笔，写信自言'找素材是最不费力的部分'；同时又以最严的匠艺研究对位法（亲抄巴赫作品、为《弦乐四重奏》题献海顿）。1791年12月5日逝于维也纳，《安魂曲》未竟，葬于贫民墓。其'简单而不浅薄'的语言、戏剧性的结构直觉与多线并行的高产，构成另一种与巴赫相对的创造原型：在流动与游戏中的系统。
historical_significance_en: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756-1791), born in Salzburg into a musical family, toured European courts from age six as 'the miracle of God.' In 1781 he broke with the Archbishop and became one of Vienna's first freelance musicians, living on commissions, publishing, performing and teaching. In just 35 years he left over 600 works across every genre of his day: 41 symphonies, 27 piano concertos, extensive chamber music, and operas—The Marriage of Figaro (1786), Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte (1790), The Magic Flute (1791)—fusing musical fabric with dramatic psychology for the first time, letting the orchestra 'think for the characters.' He often completed works whole in his head before writing them down, writing that finding material 'was the least laborious part'; yet he studied counterpoint with the strictest craft, copying out Bach by hand and dedicating six quartets to Haydn. He died in Vienna on 5 December 1791, the Requiem unfinished, buried in a pauper's grave. His language of 'simple yet never shallow,' his dramatic instinct for structure, and his prolific parallel output form a creative archetype opposite to Bach's: a system moving in play.
description_zh: 流动创造者的思维原型：先在头脑中把整体听见再落笔，用戏剧性的角色视角组织任何体裁，把外来风格消化为母语，在古典形式的约束里玩出即兴的自由，以面向听众的效果意识换取多线并行的高产。
description_en: The prototype of the flowing creator: hear the whole in the mind before setting pen to paper, organize any genre from a dramatic character's point of view, digest foreign styles into a native tongue, play improvised freedom inside classical forms, and trade effect-consciousness toward the listener for prolific parallel output.
key_concepts: 脑内整体构思（先听见后写）
音乐戏剧化（乐团刻画人物心理）
体裁互渗（歌剧手法进入交响曲与协奏曲）
古典形式的游戏化（约束中的即兴）
风格消化（J.C.巴赫、海顿、亨德尔 → 母语化）
神童加速学习（6岁巡演、8岁作交响曲）
